The keys, the mouse buttons and the cursors, with the classes that follow the keyboard layout and turn the key bindings of an application into keys.
Learn: [Keyboard and shortcuts](/use/learn/interactivity/keyboard/), [Hover and tooltips](/use/learn/interactivity/hover-and-tooltips/#change-the-cursor-over-a-node).

| Type | Kind | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| [`Cursor`](/reference/input/cursor/) | enum | The shape of the mouse pointer that a node shows while the pointer is over it. |
| [`IKeyResolver`](/reference/input/ikeyresolver/) | interface | Turns a key binding of your application into the key that it stands for, so that a shortcut can take that binding. |
| [`Key`](/reference/input/key/) | enum | A key of the keyboard, as the key events, the shortcuts and the key state name it. |
| [`KeyLayout`](/reference/input/keylayout/) | class | Translates the place of a letter or punctuation key into the key that the keyboard layout of the user types there. |
| [`KeyResolver`](/reference/input/keyresolver/) | class | The registry of the key resolvers that turn the bindings of your application into keys for shortcuts. |
| [`KeyState`](/reference/input/keystate/) | class | Remembers which key each held place of the keyboard typed, so that a release and a held test use the key of its press. |
| [`MouseButton`](/reference/input/mousebutton/) | enum | A mouse button, as the mouse events of nodes and UIs report it. |
